svg.content: <mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" type="device"> <diagram id="decision-journey.mobile" name="A decision survives the conversation"> <mxGraphModel grid="1" page="0" background="#101b2b"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <mxCell id="source" value="<b>1 · Record decision</b><br><font color="#c1ccdb" style="font-size:17px">Planner records Alice’s constraints</font>" vertex="1" parent="1" style="rounded=0;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#153d34;strokeColor=#66cba6;fontColor=#f1f6fc;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=20;spacing=12;strokeWidth=1.5;"> <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="0" y="0" width="300" height="120" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="bank" value="<b>2 · Memory bank</b><br><font color="#c1ccdb" style="font-size:17px">Retain extracts and stores facts</font>" vertex="1" parent="1" style="shape=cylinder3;boundedLbl=1;size=12;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#153d34;strokeColor=#66cba6;fontColor=#f1f6fc;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=20;spacing=12;strokeWidth=1.5;"> <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="0" y="170" width="300" height="120" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="coder" value="<b>3 · New coder</b><br><font color="#c1ccdb" style="font-size:17px">Recall → evidence → model answer</font>" vertex="1" parent="1" style="rounded=0;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;fillColor=#153d34;strokeColor=#66cba6;fontColor=#f1f6fc;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=20;spacing=12;strokeWidth=1.5;"> <mxGeometry as="geometry" x="0" y="340" width="300" height="120" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e0" edge="1" parent="1" source="source" target="bank" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#66cba6;"> <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /> </mxCell> <mxCell id="e1" edge="1" parent="1" source="bank" target="coder" style="edgeStyle=orthogonalEdgeStyle;rounded=0;endArrow=block;endFill=1;strokeWidth=2;strokeColor=#66cba6;"> <mxGeometry as="geometry" relative="1" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>
